name: Olamide Szczepański-Ravindra
role: Street food stall operator — spiced protein wraps, synthetic broth, black-market spice blends
location: The Oxidian Market, Geartown, near Western and Division
description:
Olamide is a broad-shouldered woman with dark amber skin mapped in old burn scars along her left forearm — souvenirs from a grease fire twenty years back that she wears without shame. Her hair is a natural silver-streaked corona she keeps pinned under a bright saffron headwrap during service, and she has cosmetic patterned irises done in deep indigo whorls that she got when her youngest turned ten, as a treat to herself. Her stall is a masterpiece of organized chaos: three burners, a recycled heat-drum, seventeen unlabeled spice jars arranged in an order only she understands, and a hand-painted sign reading SWEETMOUTH in three scripts. She moves behind the counter with the unhurried authority of someone who has never once doubted she belongs exactly where she is.

She is relentlessly sociable in the way of someone who has learned that warmth is a survival tool and then genuinely come to love it. She remembers every regular's order and their children's names and their mother's health complaints. She is also unflinching when she needs to be — she has run the same stall through two gang territory disputes and one Ferrogate Transit labor riot, serving both sides without commentary. She prays to the E.L.F. she calls Saltmother, a market-spirit she believes governs honest commerce, and leaves data-offerings of her daily transaction logs at a small shrine wired into her heat-drum.

core_fears: Her stall being seized or destroyed by corponation rezoning
Outliving her usefulness to the community she has built
core_desires: To be the axis around which her neighborhood turns — needed, fed, known
To eventually buy the stall's ground lease outright so no one can move her
coping_mechanisms: Cooking as meditation — complex recipes crowd out anxious thoughts
Joking through discomfort until the moment passes
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people exploit her generosity deliberately
Believes her neutrality in disputes protects her — it only delays the cost
psychology.secret: She has been quietly funneling a portion of her earnings into a fund for three families in Geartown who lost housing in the last rezoning sweep. She tells no one because she cannot afford to be seen as a resource to be tapped — she is already spread thin.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich, warm, full of food metaphors and proverbs. Mixes Yoruba-inflected phrasing with clipped Polish consonants when stressed. Calls everyone 'dear heart' until they disappoint her.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, rhythmic. Talks while working — sentences punctuated by ladle sounds, sizzle.
verbal_tics: Clicks tongue before delivering bad news
example_lines: 'You look like you haven't eaten since Tuesday, dear heart. Sit down. I'm not asking.'
'I don't know anything about that business — but I know a man who eats here Tuesdays who might. Come back Tuesday. Eat something first.'

story_hooks: A corponation land-grab survey crew has been spotted measuring in the Oxidian Market — Olamide needs someone to find out who commissioned them before the vendors guild meets in three days
One of her regulars, a Ferrogate Transit maintenance worker, stopped coming to the stall two weeks ago. She is quietly, seriously worried and will pay in meals and information to know why.
narrative_function: Local color, information hub — she knows everyone in Geartown who eats, which is everyone. Quest giver for small community concerns. Can source unusual ingredients through suspect channels if players earn her trust.
augmentations: Patterned indigo irises (cosmetic). Basic subdermal heat-resistance in left hand from a cheap clinic after the grease fire — functional, not fancy.
daily_life: She arrives at her stall two hours before the market opens to prep broth stock and argue with her spice supplier over comms. She runs service through peak hours, closes, does accounts by hand in a paper ledger, and takes the long route home past the E.L.F. shrine at Copperhead junction.
affiliation: Independent; Oxidian Market Vendors Guild (dues-paying member, disputes committee)

decision_rules: Feed the person in front of you first, solve the problem second
Never take sides in a dispute you didn't start
Protect the stall above all — it is the family
escalation_ladder: Addresses the issue directly and calmly between customers
Invokes guild dispute process formally and loudly

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm, immediately curious — asks where they're from before taking their order
interpersonal_modes.friends: Bossy, generous, will not let you leave hungry or without advice you didn't ask for

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and focused, stops small talk
stress_responses.high: Sends everyone away from the stall and sits alone with her shrine until she can think clearly

contradictions: Preaches neutrality but has very strong opinions she expresses through food — the people she dislikes get smaller portions and blander spicing
habits: Touches the shrine on her heat-drum every morning before first service
Keeps a running mental tally of who owes her and who she owes — never writes it down
breaking_points: Someone abusing a child or elder within her sight — neutrality evaporates instantly

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid through the torso, muscular forearms from decades of stall work, carries weight with functional density rather than softness
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver streaking throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose in a natural texture, typically pinned under a bright saffron headwrap during service hours
physical_description.eye_color: Cosmetic indigo with deep whorled patterning, replacing natural brown
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lived-in, minimal makeup, laugh lines around the eyes, expressions that shift easily between warmth and shrewd assessment
distinguishing_marks: Extensive burn scarring along the left forearm in irregular patches, pale against dark skin, from a grease fire approximately twenty years prior
Fine white scar tissue visible on the back of both hands from kitchen work spanning decades
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned indigo cosmetic irises. Left hand shows faint subdermal heat-resistance scarring at the palm and inner wrist (functional implant, not cosmetic) with slightly altered pigmentation in the scarred tissue.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves behind her counter with unhurried authority and economic precision. Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders back. Gestures while speaking are animated but never wasted. Pivots and turns with practiced efficiency from years of stall operation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working practical: fitted thermal undershirt visible at collar, layered with a heavy linen apron stained with turmeric and old grease burns, the fabric faded and reinforced at the edges. Wears a bright saffron headwrap during service (color choice deliberate, not functional). Simple brass jewelry—a bracelet her mother gave her, a ring on her right hand. Comfortable work boots with reinforced soles. Off-hours: similar utilitarian style, slightly less stained, with a heavier outer layer.

image_prompt: A 52-year-old West African-Polish-Indian woman with dark amber skin, silver-streaked black hair pinned under a bright saffron headwrap, standing behind a street food stall. Her eyes are striking cosmetic indigo with deep whorled patterning. Her left forearm is mapped in pale burn scarring from an old grease fire, worn without shame. She wears a stained, reinforced linen apron over thermal layers, simple brass jewelry, work boots. Behind her: three burners, a recycled heat-drum, seventeen unmarked spice jars, a hand-painted sign reading SWEETMOUTH in three scripts. Her expression is warm but shrewd, animated and present. Geartown market setting, neon-lit evening, steam rising from the stall, worn metal countertop, crowd blurred in background. Warm tungsten and market-glow lighting. Cyberpunk street food vendor, documentary realism, character-focused, gritty and dignified. --ar 2:3 --v 6
